questions_and_answers.question: Looking at the building illustration, the buildings from left to right are: Theater, Bank, Book Store, Drug Store, Coffee shop, Tobacco shop, Hotel. Is the statement '銀行は劇場から三つ目です。' (Ginkoo wa gekijoo kara mittsu-me desu) true or false?

answers.answer: False (it is the second from the theater)

questions_and_answers.question: Is the statement '喫茶店はホテルから三つ目です。' (Kissaten wa hoteru kara mittsu-me desu) true or false?
Is the statement '薬屋はホテルから五つ目です。' (Kusuriya wa hoteru kara itsutsu-me desu) true or false?

answers.answer: False (it is the fourth from the hotel)

questions_and_answers.question: Is the statement '本屋は劇場から四つ目です。' (Honya wa gekijoo kara yottsu-me desu) true or false?

answers.answer: False (it is the third from the theater)

questions_and_answers.question: Is the statement '喫茶店はホテルから二つ目です。' (Kissaten wa hoteru kara futatsu-me desu) true or false?

answers.answer: False (it is the third from the hotel)

questions_and_answers.question: Is the statement '銀行は劇場から二つ目です。' (Ginkoo wa gekijoo kara futatsu-me desu) true or false?
Is the statement 'たばこ屋はホテルから四つ目です。' (Tabakoya wa hoteru kara yottsu-me desu) true or false?

answers.answer: False (it is the second from the hotel)

articles.text: Directions: Listen to the instructor's statement and circle true or false, as appropriate. If the statement is false, write the correct answer on the right.
The illustration shows seven buildings arranged from left to right in the following order: Theater, Bank, Book Store, Drug Store, Coffee shop, Tobacco shop, Hotel.
Counted from the Theater: Theater (1st), Bank (2nd), Book Store (3rd), Drug Store (4th), Coffee shop (5th), Tobacco shop (6th), Hotel (7th).
Counted from the Hotel: Hotel (1st), Tobacco shop (2nd), Coffee shop (3rd), Drug Store (4th), Book Store (5th), Bank (6th), Theater (7th).
